title: A story's examples are history once the story is done
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. Examples became history at a cut's integration.
decision: A story's examples are history once the story is done: they record what it was reviewed against and no longer state the design. The current design is the concepts; an example that should keep standing is kept by a decision naming it. Examples of integrated cuts stay history.
consequences: The record's views show standing examples apart from history.
